item.description: Join BARE!Applications are closed. Be part of something creative. If you write, design, photograph, or love bold ideas, BARE is the place for you. item.title: About
item.description: Meet BARE,an arts & culture magazine at UC Berkeley est. 2007. Every semester, BARE explores a new contemporary theme through photoshoots, creative writing, original art, and social commentary. Our members’ diverse visions and voices bring our magazine to life. Interested in joining BARE? Coffee chat us below, or learn more about our departments here.

item.title: BARE Artist Fund
item.description: BARE Artist Fund Calling all creatives! BARE offers grants for historically underrepresented creatives at UC Berkeley. Whether it’s your next project or your first big idea, we’re here to help you make it happen. ApplyMessage lunacoyle@berkeley.edu and sophie_mark@berkeley.edu to inquire about the grant application. item.title: Home
item.description: Hey There, We’re BARE BARE is UC, Berkeley’s premier arts and culture magazine. Since our debut in 2007, BARE has gained prominence on campus and national recognition in New York Times and Teen Vogue. Once primarily a fashion column, the publication has evolved into an amalgamation of social commentary, personal narrative, and multimedia design.
